resolution: Generation 2 is accepted only as the deterministic repository-hosted release-readback fence layered over the separately accepted generation-1 release transaction ABI. The accepted evidence proves fail-closed planned-release versus observed-active-release validation and re-executes the G1 transaction regression. It does not prove that a release ZIP was installed, that a target process consumed the attested bytes, or that any target/VPS/physical runtime succeeded.
next_exact_action: Keep WP1207 G2 closed unless new executable counterevidence invalidates this component scope. Route the next exact-source promotion gate through the existing ReleaseManifest/readback substrate plus a nonduplicate same-bytes loader/import consumption witness, then require a clean exact-source target-runtime receipt before any higher evidence credit.
